mechanism: Betamethasone may increase fenofibrate levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and glucuronidation effects, while fenofibrate can enhance corticosteroid-induced hyperglycemia and dyslipidemia; concurrent use increases risk of myopathy and metabolic complications.
action: Monitor for signs of myopathy (muscle pain, weakness), hyperglycemia, and lipid levels; consider alternative corticosteroid or fibrate if possible; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
